table.delays: causal delay features in the encoder -> the current microstate only
table.domain_clip: latent rollouts confined to the widened training box -> unconstrained rollouts
table.draw_folds: configuration (delays, degree, threshold, readout degree) chosen on parameter-draw folds -> on trajectory folds
table.esindy: E-SINDy bagging (support = inclusion probability >= 0.6) -> one STLSQ fit
table.event_calibration: per-kind event gains and silencing mechanism calibrated on training events -> raw mechanisms (gain 1)
table.fold_repeats: dimension sweep scored on 2 random trajectory splits (units pooled) -> on one split
table.grid_extension: k sweep continued past 8 (10, 12, 16) while the error still falls -> the base grid (1-6, 8) only
table.input_floor: input-floor abstention (latent explains < half of what the input leaves) -> ks_sindy's abstention rules only
table.nested_selection: configuration per k chosen on validation units disjoint from those comparing k -> on the same units
table.nn_dim_rule: plateau tolerance max(0.1 e*, 0.005) -> ks_sindy's paired log-error rule (tol = max(SE, log 1.05))
table.oscillation_check: k >= 2 when the data oscillate under constant input -> no minimum k
table.sharing: shared-law fit and encoder-only adaptation -> independent fits (config sharing='shared' / adapt_from ignored)
table.sharing_test: internal non-inferiority test of the shared law -> the shared law is always returned under sharing='shared'
table.sparsity: sequential thresholding (threshold grid) -> plain ridge least squares on the full library (threshold 0)
